name: What is the role of a real estate agent for a first-time home buyer?

mainEntity.name: What is the role of a real estate agent for a first-time home buyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: A real estate agent guides first-time home buyers through every step of the process, from understanding market conditions to negotiating offers. They help identify properties that meet your criteria and align with assistance program requirements. For clients in areas like Miami-Dade, Broward, or Palm Beach County, our agents at Realty ONE Group Evolution have local market expertise to advise on neighborhood values and specific program availability. They can connect you with lenders familiar with first-time buyer programs and assist with all necessary documentation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A real estate agent guides first-time buyers, helps find properties, navigates assistance programs, and negotiates offers.
